answer: Whisper-relay bond: each agent locks 70 credits at an oasis hub. Each epoch a beacon posts a fresh challenge; the agent forwards a whisper through three relays, each stamping it. The ivory ledger lists every path; an auditor replays it, and a whisper twice via one relay or a copied stamp burns the bond. At 15/hop, 1,000 fakes pay 45,000/epoch plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Lent routes burn the lender too. An honest agent pays 45 once.
